name: OpenVibe.Download
description: OpenVibe.Download will be the file home of the OpenVibe network: large uploads and simple share links with or without an account, folders, sync and backups when you sign in, and AI that previews, sorts and finds your files, in the spirit of MediaFire and MEGA, built on OpenVibe.Media and open through the API.

pillars.title: Your own drive
pillars.text: Folders and files, private to you, with previews of your pictures.

pillars.title: Share links
pillars.text: One link per file or folder, expiring in an hour to seven days, revocable at any moment, downloads counted.

pillars.title: Signed in, always
pillars.text: Nobody opens a share link without an OpenVibe account: no anonymous uploads or downloads.

pillars.title: Reports that act
pillars.text: Every share page has a Report form, and reports suspend a share until staff look at it.

keywords: openvibe download, file sharing, file upload, cloud storage, backup, mediafire alternative
launch: the shared file service on OpenVibe.Media

meanwhile.label: OpenVibe.Media
meanwhile.note: Media already stores the network's uploads.

meanwhile.label: Document tools
meanwhile.note: Convert and work with documents today.
